high_level_description: The image is a tweet from Narendra Modi, the Prime Minister of India, posted on his official Twitter account (@narendramodin). The tweet reads: "A memorable selfie with my friend Nazim. I was impressed by the good work he's doing. At the public meeting he requested a selfie and was happy to meet him. My best wishes for his future endeavours." The tweet includes a photo of two men taking a selfie together. The man on the left appears to be Nazim, wearing a white jacket, and the man on the right is Narendra Modi, dressed in traditional Indian attire with a scarf draped over his shoulder
